# IGRA test-fixture attribution

These small synthetic fixed-width samples are derived from the publicly documented
NOAA/NCEI IGRA v2.2 layouts. They do not contain a real station archive, pilot
data, or live provider payload. They exist only for deterministic T-019 tests.

Source format documentation: NOAA/NCEI IGRA v2.2, DOI 10.7289/V5X63K0Q.
